status: All five stages implemented and verified; completion plan Phases 0-4 delivered (audit, database ORM integrations, auth, sessions, cache) — 734 runtime tests / 119 security tests; Stage 5 CLI built last
note: Core and SvelteKit are preserved. All five stages are implemented and verified: real SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL database adapters, migrations, connection pooling, Argon2id, Redis cache/session, Stage 4 process-local adapters, and the Stage 5 sveltex CLI (built last) all ship with integration or runtime tests. 734 runtime tests, 119 security tests and 16 type-test projects pass (0 failures, 0 skipped) with live PostgreSQL 16, MySQL 8.0 and Redis 7 services. CI provisions those services. Generated apps never depend on the CLI at runtime; optional ORM integrations (Drizzle/Kysely behind optional peers) and BYO ORM adapters ship with real PostgreSQL tests, while built-in Prisma/MikroORM/TypeORM, WebSocket/SSE, S3 and SMTP/HTTP adapters are documented as unshipped; no fake provider is advertised. Phase 2 extended @sveltex/auth with a concrete FixedWindowLimiter, TokenManager (single-use/expiring/purpose-scoped), PasswordResetService, EmailVerificationService and deny-by-default RBAC; OAuth2/OIDC and MFA remain explicitly out of scope. Phase 3 extended @sveltex/session with __Host- secure cookie defaults + SessionCookieTransport, double-submit CSRF (optional HMAC session binding), a persistent DatabaseSessionStore tested against real SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL, first-class per-user revocation (memory/Redis/SQL), and an AuthSessionPort bridge verified with a real AuthService + Argon2Hasher. SvelteKit handle-hook wiring remains Phase 10. Phase 4 extended @sveltex/cache with a typed error hierarchy, a strict versioned serialization envelope, escaped namespaces, key/prefix/predicate/tag invalidation (Redis INCR generations), an observable graceful-fallback circuit breaker, process-local single-flight with TTL jitter, and six new subpath exports; a distributed lock and additional backends are not claimed. The Existing Package Completion Plan is the active roadmap (Phases 0-4 delivered; Phases 5-12 remain).
